meta.name: surgical
meta.description: Forces Claude to match output scope exactly to what was requested. Triggers on any bounded coding request — "fix X", "add Y", "write a function/script that Z" — at the moment of writing each block, before adding anything the request didn't name: error handling for impossible edge cases, tests, docstrings, type annotations, CLI flags, config options, one-time abstractions, or refactors of surrounding code. Does NOT trigger when error handling, tests, or validation are the explicit subject of the request, or when the user asked for a complete or production-ready implementation. The best code is code you didn't write.

copy.tagline: 只写被要求的内容，不添加多余代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常发现AI自动添加了未要求的错误处理或测试
copy.tagline_en: Write only what is requested, no extra code
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often find AI adding unrequested error handling or tests

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 写代码时只输出你明确要求的内容，不会擅自添加错误处理、测试、文档、类型注解、CLI 参数、配置选项、抽象或重构等未请求的代码。
howto.when: 当你提出有边界的编码请求，例如“修复 X”、“添加 Y”、“写一个函数/脚本实现 Z”时，在写每个代码块之前触发。如果请求本身是关于错误处理、测试或验证，则不触发。

say.text: 写一个函数，把输入的数字翻倍。
修复这个 bug：日期格式化成 YYYY-MM-DD。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude writes only the code you explicitly requested, without adding unrequested error handling, tests, docstrings, type annotations, CLI flags, config options, abstractions, or refactors.
howto.when_en: Triggers on bounded coding requests like "fix X", "add Y", "write a function/script that Z" at the moment of writing each block. Does NOT trigger when error handling, tests, or validation are the explicit subject.

say_en.text: Write a function that doubles a number.
say_en.note: Claude returns only the double(n) function, no extra validation or tests.

say_en.text: Fix this bug: format a date as YYYY-MM-DD.
say_en.note: Claude fixes only the specified bug, no refactoring or tests added.
